purpose: 展示真实帮助文本，观察现有比较指出的休眠规则说明差异；不以文档措辞追加产品断言。
output:
usage: edgefleet [demo|version|aggregate --window-ms <milliseconds> [--partitions <count>]|help]

commands:
  demo       run a built-in fleet health demonstration
  version    print the edgefleet version
  aggregate  aggregate JSON events from standard input into fixed windows
  help       show this help

aggregate:
  edgefleet aggregate --window-ms <milliseconds> [--partitions <count>]

  --window-ms is a required positive signed 64-bit integer. Aggregation runs
  fully offline and never uses the current time; all timing comes from input.

  standard input is line-delimited JSON with two record types:
    {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5}
    {"type":"watermark","time":2000}
  time is a non-negative signed 64-bit millisecond timestamp, value is a
  signed 64-bit integer, and key is a non-empty string. Blank lines are
  ignored, but error line numbers count every physical input line.

  windows start at time zero, have the fixed length given by --window-ms
  and are left-closed, right-open: [start,end). Every valid event for a key
  in a window contributes to its count and sum; windows with no events do
  not produce output. Records may arrive out of order; window membership
  uses event time only.

  a watermark declares that events with time below it are late. Before the
  first watermark every valid event is accepted. After a watermark, every
  window whose end is less than or equal to the watermark is closed once
  and emitted as one JSON line with key,start,end,count,sum; the sum is a
  signed 64-bit integer. Closures are ordered by end ascending and then by
  key in UTF-8 byte order. Watermarks may jump or repeat, and an event at
  exactly the current watermark is still valid; events below the current
  watermark are skipped with a note on standard error.

  --partitions merges several independent input sources of the same stream.
  <count> must be a positive signed 64-bit integer. When it is given, every
  event and watermark record must additionally carry an integer partition in
  [0,count):
    {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5,"partition":0}
    {"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}
  each partition advances its own watermark independently. No effective
  watermark exists until every partition has reported at least once;
  afterwards the effective watermark is the minimum of the per-partition
  values, and window closure and late-event checks use that minimum, so one
  partition's larger watermark can never close a window or drop an event
  ahead of the others. A partition watermark may repeat or jump forward but
  never move backwards. Events from different partitions for the same key
  and window merge into one count and sum; output records never include a
  partition field. Without --partitions the command keeps the single
  watermark behavior and ignores extra fields.

  a partition with no data for a while can be declared idle:
    {"type":"idle","partition":1}
  while idle the partition is excluded from the effective watermark, so the
  remaining partitions can advance it and close windows; the idle record
  itself can trigger closure. Repeated idle records are no-ops. Idle is a
  declared input fact, never inferred from elapsed time or read intervals.
  An event for an idle partition is fatal; the next watermark for the
  partition resumes it and must be at least both its previous watermark and
  the current effective watermark (equal bounds are allowed). Idle is not a
  valid record type without --partitions.

  at end of input the watermark is not advanced and still-open windows are
  not emitted. Malformed JSON, missing or mistyped fields, out-of-range
  integers, unknown record types, missing or out-of-range partitions,
  partition watermark regression, events for idle partitions, idle resume
  bounds below the previous or effective watermark, and window-end or
  cumulative-sum overflow print the line number and reason to standard
  error and exit non-zero; earlier output is retained. Standard output
  contains window results only.

purpose: 共同输入展示休眠关窗、重复声明、全部休眠后的等边界恢复、迟到判断及待输出事件保留。
共同示例用1999恢复，展示保留的窗口结果及带物理行号、分区和2000边界的真实错误。
